review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only C bundle. Only OPT-1 creates implementation and verification obligations here. The exact four-file writable scope matches the runtime owner, maintained public declaration and regression/type-test owners; package.json supplies inspection evidence for xo, ava and tsd without requiring a configuration edit. Runtime evidence supports reusing the existing sampled, rounded and capped delay, including decreasing backoff and zero delay, and identifies the necessary post-hook cancellation check and hook-throw precedence before waiting. TASK-VERIFY is independent and depends on TASK-IMPLEMENT, with both roles required to cover every required AC. The allowed agents have matching delivery roles, auto-assignable memberships, available capacity and supplied active project-scoped trusted claims for the relevant contract, data, state, asynchronous consumer, language, failure-handling and testing capabilities; the verifier additionally has testing.verification. Pending security.authorization claims do not establish trusted capability, but this requirement does not introduce an authorization obligation. The distinct configured reviewer satisfies the supplied non-executing independent-review prerequisite. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree across repository, source, team, decisions, prompts, policy, model, sampling and budgets. The supplied provenance explains the separate manifest/evaluation digest domains and trim-only PRD persistence. Earlier preparation fields and retained old-bundle operations do not constitute current-bundle candidates or override the frozen preview. This approval relies on the supplied Service binding and provenance assertions: I did not recompute digests, execute code, attest human confirmation or infer test success. The truncated test.js excerpt limits inspection of existing regression details, but does not undermine the supplied owner scope or these planning expectations. No material error or unresolved ambiguity was identified.
